steps.description: There is a **crate** that is observed at the left of the elevator. You will need to pull it onto the **platform**, and activate the control to raise the elevator.

- In the case of you pushing the **crate** to the right, it will catch on the pivoting **platform**.
- You have to place the **crate** on the left of the **platform**, and pull the elevator **platform** to the right.
- Be sure to activate the control to make sure it isn't pulled back to the left.
The elevator will finally hold the pivot down, allowing you to push the **crate** under the **rope**, in which you can climb.
